# Component identity V1 fixture

These are the published JavaScript and Gear-owned bridge artifacts from commit
`812195f`, before component identity schema V2. They are test evidence only and
must never be imported or executed.

The original raw inputs are preserved so the compatibility test can recompute
the sealed V1 identity instead of trusting a release name or a hash allowlist.
The fixture `package.json` SHA-256 is
`1cc82968e633da5e6d7d766da8bc1231719c3f8e7f9ee5eae2fbf47c801f2a48`;
`lib/evolution/components.js` is
`9f5c06ac68dc7e56a37534e2536c43c41cc03c1dbb0fecc641cfe8a3d6918cb7`.
